01 /

Eligibility and your account

You must be at least 18 and permitted to participate where you are. Provide accurate account and verification information. Keep your password and email codes private. You are responsible for the activity you authorise through your account.

02 /

Placing a stake

Review the game, selection, odds, amount and potential return before confirming. A stake is accepted only when recorded by the server. Accepted stakes retain their recorded odds. Requests for unavailable games, changed quotes or insufficient funds can be refused.

03 /

Results and void games

Final scores entered by an administrator determine settlement. A winning return includes the stake according to the accepted decimal odds; a loss forfeits the stake. A void single is refunded. A void leg in a multiple has odds of 1.00; other legs continue to determine the result.

04 /

Copy staking and risk

Funding an active copy position authorises the strategy’s future published picks according to its settings and available allocation. You can pause future copying. Unsettled stakes must finish before closing a position. No strategy or return is guaranteed.

05 /

Payments and promotional credit

Card credits depend on payment confirmation; manual credits depend on administrator verification. Withdrawal requests require approved KYC, sufficient available funds, the applicable minimum and administrator review. Promotional codes are single-use and may expire or be revoked before redemption.

Payment rules ↗
06 /

Fair use and questions

Do not attempt to access another person’s account, manipulate requests, submit false payment evidence or interfere with the service. Report suspected errors with the relevant reference through account support. Platform availability and external payment processing can vary.
